name: NeuralVDB
definition: A hybrid data structure that replaces the lower nodes of a shallow and wide VDB tree structure with multiple hierarchical neural networks to encode topology and value information, reducing memory footprints by orders of magnitude while maintaining spatial adaptivity.
summary: NeuralVDB is a hybrid data structure that replaces lower VDB tree nodes with neural networks to achieve significantly higher compression ratios for sparse 3D data while maintaining spatial adaptivity.
